How to use this tool ▼
The flow
  • Enter the agent's name, phone, and email username. Title stays locked to the standard designation — unlock it only if it differs.
  • Phone auto-formats to T 000 000 0000; email auto-fills from the name (j.doe). Edit either anytime.
  • Check the live preview, then Download Front and Download Back.
Multiple agents
  • Use + to add an agent, the arrows to move between them, or CSV to import a batch.
  • CSV columns: First, Last, Phone (Title, Email, Domain optional). A header row is detected automatically.
  • Download all card fronts appears with 2+ agents — a CSV batch downloads as a single ZIP.
Good to know
  • The dashed line on each preview is the trim line — the card is cut there. Everything outside it is print bleed and gets trimmed off.
  • The back is the same for everyone, so there's a single Download Back.
